openings.evidence: Predicted points lie behind this wall patch; geometry cannot distinguish an opening from prediction error or occlusion.

shell.fitPolicy: Merge near-coplanar patches; reject sparse lower ceiling-like patches that may be objects. Inspect retained and missing surfaces against photos.
shell.note: Only observed planar patches are fitted. Unseen boundaries are not completed. Opening candidates remain disabled until reviewed; these surfaces are not construction measurements.

dimensions.assumption: Visible floor proportions approximate the complete room.

limitations: Room scale is an assumption until calibrated with a real measurement.
Camera consistency does not verify room identity or accuracy.
